verdict.rationale: Ente's FAQ documents a FaceID lock under Settings → Security → Lockscreen, and the Auth v4 blog adds a custom lock screen supporting PINs and passwords, so both the biometric and PIN halves of the story are covered by first-party docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the lock screen, and detailed documentation of lock behavior such as auto-lock timing and biometric support beyond FaceID across platforms.
